prose: Simon Willison, in a one-paragraph note: the more time he spends working with coding agents, the more convinced he is that they make software engineering even harder. They can do amazing things - but unlocking their full potential requires extraordinary discipline and knowledge.
highlights: Willison: coding agents make software engineering harder, not easier
Amazing results are possible, but demand extraordinary discipline and knowledge
A one-paragraph note from the field's most prolific agent user
